name: sloplint
description: Checks your writing for the phrases and rhythms that make it read as AI-written, and shows you each one. It runs a real scanner, so it needs somewhere to run code — it will tell you plainly if it cannot. Everything runs on your machine, with one exception you choose each time: if you have a TypeSafe API key, it can also ask a model about the text, and it asks you before sending anything.
